author: DJI
description:
Introducing the DJI ROMO 2 Series, DJI's next-generation flagship robot vacuum, built on the advanced sensing technology and mechatronics behind DJI drones.

DJI ROMO 2 Series adapts in real time for an intelligent clean. From sensing to action, AI powers every step — reading each mess, choosing the right strategy, and reaching the edges other robots miss. With deep, thorough cleaning across both hard floors and carpets, and a self-cleaning base station that keeps itself spotless for up to 365 days, DJI ROMO 2 Series lets you enjoy a cleaner home with less effort than ever.

✅ AI-Powered Multi-Scenario Adaptation
✅ Precise Edge-Hugging Cleaning
✅ Next-Gen Self-Cleaning for 365 Days of Maintenance-Free Operation
✅ 36,000Pa Powerful Suction
✅ Exceptional Anti-Tangle Performance
✅ 8.5cm Obstacle Crossing
✅ Millimeter-Level Obstacle Sensing Powered by Drone Technology
✅ 85% Noise Reduction

Early bird discount is live — September 9–30. 
Click 👉 https://brnw.ch/21x5oS5   or search "DJI ROM
title: Meet DJI ROMO 2 Series — Thinks Deeper. Cleans Smarter.
